title: Lina & Max
description: Lina has doubts about Max… Is he really faithful?

questions.question: Max keeps telling me about a new sponsorship project for his water polo club. He says it's an incredible opportunity. Can you tell me who he's been talking to about managing it?
Thanks! He has training tonight, tell me what time it's supposed to start?
OK thanks. Last night, he was on the couch laughing by himself on Snap... as soon as I came close, he locked his phone right away! Can you tell me who he was talking to?
questions.hint: Look for recent conversations on Snap.

questions.question: And what were they talking about?
questions.hint: Read the content of their exchanges.

questions.question: Just rugby? I don't buy that for a second, he wouldn't have jumped like that. Dig a little deeper, they were probably talking about other things with Jean… Tell me what he's hiding from me
OK… I know Max too well, he kept that photo. Give me the Google Photos password to access it please.
questions.hint: You need to find the password for Google Photos, you can find it in the conversation with his brother. For the email, same thing, read the conversation with Liam.

questions.question: Thanks you're amazing! Try to find out who the person is that Max is close with in the photo please, give me their first name.
questions.hint: Look carefully at the photo, she has a badge.

questions.question: Damn so it's Olivia… Right now we have no money left, but he keeps transferring money from our joint account to his personal PayPal… I'm sure he's buying her gifts. Find the name of the store where he made his last purchase.
questions.hint: Check his PayPal purchases, to find the password, look at the conv with his brother.

questions.question: Did he book a getaway or a trip for her? If so, what?
How much did he pay?
questions.hint: Check the total amount of the reservation.

questions.question: €713… How much is he spending on her… Check his PayPal history, look for another big expense. How much is it?
What? 200 bucks again! What did he spend it on?
They seem to see each other quite often… He thinks I'm stupid… Tell me where he is right now please?
Am I the only person who can see his location? If not, who else has it?
Boutil? What's that email? Find me the first and last name of the person who uses that account!
questions.hint: In Gmail, search for an email from boutil and look at the signature.

questions.question: Olivia again... It's over, he disgusts me! He's such a piece of trash! Give me Olivia's number, I'm going to settle this right now!
questions.hint: Look for the phone number in contacts.

textSuccess: It's over… Thanks for finding the truth. Olivia Tilbou, the gifts, the chalet, the restaurant… It was all right there in front of me. He's been lying to me for months. Now I have the proof, and I know exactly what I need to do.

onboardingContent.text: I've been told you're good at finding out what people are hiding. I really need someone like you.

My name is Lina. Max and I have been together for 2 years. Between his job and his water polo training, we've never been rich. But right now things are really tough… He doesn't earn much, water polo doesn't pay the bills, and I lost my job a few weeks ago.

The thing is, despite all that, our money keeps disappearing and I can't figure out why. Max is more and more busy, he comes home late, he's always on his phone… He says it's work and the club, but I have a bad feeling. I managed to get hold of his phone. Help me find out what he's hiding from me.
